intent_snapshot.goal: Implement Slice S6 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md (Initiative deepen-authority-seams): the Authority Store exposes one Run-exact read of a Task's settled Run; modules outside runtime/kernel stop reading Run rows; the forwarding readTaskRecord export is removed. No schema or migration change.

acceptance.assertion: Per D6 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md (sources U1, E5): runtime/kernel/storage.ts exposes one read that, for a Task in this worktree, returns the settled Run's identity, its identity-validated record, its proof, whether its audit pair is exported, and the raw bytes needed for byte-exact comparison. Positive: a settled Task returns its own Run. Negative: an active Task or a Task with no Run returns null. Bound: for a Task with two Runs the read never returns the other Run's record or proof. Agreed seams: tests/task-record-durability.test.ts, tests/kernel-enrollment-transaction.test.ts.

Per D6 and the prohibited-coupling rule of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md: no module outside plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel imports sqlite_store or reads Run rows; batch reconfirmation, preflight ownership and batch commit use the settled Run read; audit paths in batch_reconfirmation.ts come from storage_paths.ts; the enroll-<task>-<created_at> Run-id convention is defined once. Positive: reconfirmation, own-claim detection and batch commit behave as before. Negative: the boundary test fails when a module outside runtime/kernel imports sqlite_store. Agreed seams: tests/kernel-r2c2-boundary.test.ts, tests/batch-plan-reconfirmation.test.ts, tests/unattended-batch-commit.test.ts, tests/pi-batch-authority.test.ts. Evidence-binding invariant: before consuming an exported audit pair to create or adopt a batch child commit, its raw record revision and its complete parsed terminal proof must equal the current local settled Run evidence. Apply the same comparison to new commits, first-child recovery and every later child commit/persist recovery. Positive: a second child produced by commitBatchChild is found after a commit/persist interruption. Negative: changing only the exported proof lifecycle, terminal event id or terminalized_at is refused without changing HEAD, index, refs or persistent evidence; restoring the original proof restores success. Verify these controls through lookupBatchCommit in tests/unattended-batch-commit.test.ts, with the first child already committed.

Per D6 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md (source E5, docs/adr/0012 'Remaining coarse-key sites'): the run-blind readAuditTaskPair(root, taskId) reads in storage.ts, assurance_projection.ts and the Pi readSettledTaskRecord are Run-aware. Positive: a re-enrolled Task reads its current Run's evidence. Negative: the stale flat pair of an earlier Run is not returned. docs/adr/0012 lists the corrected remaining sites. Agreed seams: tests/kernel-assurance-projection.test.ts, tests/post-freeze-intent-resolution.test.ts.

Per D6 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md: the forwarding readTaskRecord export of runtime/kernel/storage.ts is removed and its callers use readTaskRecordRaw; the Kernel index exposes readTaskRecordRaw and not readTaskRecord. The AssuranceCoordinatorPorts member of the same name is unaffected. Agreed seams: tests/kernel-r2c1-boundary.test.ts, tests/kernel-r2c2-boundary.test.ts.

plugins/immune-brain/dist/claude/mcp-server.mjs is regenerated from the changed runtime sources and matches a fresh generate; no hand edit to the bundle. Agreed seam: tests/claude-host-package.test.ts.

attestations.summary: 已核验 manifest digest、单一 parent、review tree 及全部变更 blob；settled Run 读取、完整 proof 比较与恢复路径符合 acceptance，结合 Kernel QA 通过证据，未发现阻断问题。

findings.summary: readSettledTaskEvidence 在本地 Run 仍 active 时也 fallback 到 run-blind audit pair，可能返回其他 worktree Run 的 terminal evidence；batch_git.commitBatchChild 与 Pi readSettledTaskRecord 因此可能把未 settle 的本地 Task 当成已 settle。最小修复：fallback 前区分 active 本地 Run 与没有本地 Run 的历史证据场景，active 时直接返回 null，并在约定 seam 添加 active 本地 Run 与 stale pair 共存的拒绝断言。

evidence.trigger: 本地 store 中 task-a 的当前 Run 为 active，同时 .imm/audit/task-a/run-foreign/ 存在有效的 done record/proof，当前 Run 尚无 audit export。该状态已由 tests/kernel-enrollment-transaction.test.ts:220–276 的 fixture 建立。readSettledRunEvidence 返回 null 后，readSettledTaskEvidence 无条件调用 readAuditTaskPair(root, taskId)；storage_paths.ts:189–204 会选择唯一的 run-foreign 目录，wrapper 返回 runId:null 和 foreign terminal record。commitBatchChild 随后再次使用无 Run 参数读取同一 pair，done 检查通过；满足其余 Git lineage、scope 和 delivery 检查时可以提交尚未 settled 的本地 Task。base revision 的 batch commit 使用 localRunId 指定 active 本地 Run，原本会因其 audit pair 不存在而拒绝。新增测试仅断言底层 readSettledRunEvidence 返回 null，未覆盖 wrapper 的 fallback，因此未关闭当前本地 Run 优先、旧 Run 不得替代这一 invariant。

findings.summary: batch_git.ts:471–484 将原先针对 auditPair 的 done/proof 检查替换为 settled 检查，却仍从 auditPair 获取 scope 和 attestation，且不校验它与 store evidence 一致。store 为 done、导出 pair 被替换成自洽的 stopped record/proof 时，旧实现会拒绝，新实现可继续提交。应在使用导出 pair 前比对其 recordRevision 与 settled.recordRevision，并验证 proof 与 settled.proof 一致；scope 和 attestation 应取自已验证的 store record。

evidence.trigger: 本地 Run 已 settled done；其 run-scoped audit record 被替换为合法的 stopped record，terminal-proof.json 同步改为 stopped 并更新 final_record_hash，使 readAuditTaskPair 验证通过。该导出 record 不含 QA attestation，Git branch/HEAD 正确，待提交路径位于其 scope_hint 内。commitBatchChild 的 lifecycle/proof 检查只检查 store 的 done evidence，因此绕过原先对 stopped audit pair 的拒绝并继续提交。这属于 validation precedes merge 的覆盖缺口：分别验证 store 和 export 并未验证两者是同一份 settlement evidence。

findings.summary: AC3 在约定 seam 的负向覆盖缺失：tests/kernel-assurance-projection.test.ts 仅替换 reader 名称，未验证当前 Run 与 stale flat pair 并存时的 projection；tests/post-freeze-intent-resolution.test.ts:201 新测试调用 storage helper 且构造 foreign Run 目录，未通过 Pi readSettledTaskRecord 验证拒绝旧 flat pair。应在这两个约定文件中分别通过 projectAssurance 和 Pi readSettledTaskRecord 验证返回当前 Run 的 evidence，并拒绝旧 flat pair。

evidence.trigger: 当前本地 Run 与同 task_id 的旧 .imm/audit/<task-id>/task-record.json、terminal-proof.json 同时存在，且两份 evidence 的 intent、scope 或 lifecycle 不同。现有 AC3 suites 未通过 projectAssurance 和 Pi readSettledTaskRecord 在该状态下断言结果；新增测试只调用 readSettledTaskEvidence 并放置 foreign run-scoped pair，因此无法保护 AC3 指定的 stale-flat-pair invariant。

findings.summary: readSettledTaskEvidence 的两次独立 DB 读之间存在 settlement 交错窗口：settlement 提交但 export 未完成时，第二次读取看到 done，legacy fallback 返回另一 Run 的 pair。最小修复：用一次 DB 读区分 absent、active、terminal，仅在 absent 时允许 legacy fallback，并在约定 seam 增加 settlement 交错回归覆盖。

evidence.trigger: 本地 Run B 为 active，磁盘上只有早先 Run A 的有效 audit pair。storage.ts:1162 的 readSettledRunEvidence 读取 B 后返回 null；另一进程随后提交 B 的 settlement 而其 audit export 尚未完成；storage.ts:1170–1173 的第二次读取看到 B 为 done，跳过仅拒绝 active 的分支，执行 :1175 的 run-blind readAuditTaskPair，选到唯一已导出的 A，最终返回 runId:null 与 A 的 record/proof，Pi reader 因而投影 A 的 scope 和 intent_path。这属于 Run-exact evidence isolation 的覆盖缺口：顺序执行的 active、settled 与 stale-pair 检查未覆盖两次读取之间的状态转换。

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/runtime/unattended/batch_git.ts:478–490 弱化了导出 proof 的校验：proof-only 修改可让 batch 提交与 settled Run 矛盾的审计证据。提交前应比较完整 proof（至少 lifecycle/terminal_event_id/final_record_hash 逐字段），并在 tests/unattended-batch-commit.test.ts 增加仅修改导出 proof 的负向测试。

evidence.trigger: validation precedes merge 的覆盖缺口：本地 Run、record 和 store proof 均为 done，导出的 task-record.json 保持原字节，仅将同一 Run 的 terminal-proof.json 中 terminal_lifecycle 改为 stopped，保留 task_id、final_record_hash 和 terminal_event_id。storage.ts:1065–1100 的 readAuditTaskPair 接受该 pair；batch_git.ts:478–482 只比较 hash 和 event id，489 行检查的又是 store proof，因此全部通过并在 588–638 行提交矛盾的导出 proof、记录成功。base revision 的 batch_git.ts:470 会拒绝该输入。新增 record-identity guard 和测试同时替换 record/proof，未覆盖同一 invariant 下的 proof-only 修改。未改动的 backend_claim.ts:152–184 因 readAuditTaskPair 直接调用 parseTaskTombstone 而检查；它分别允许 done/stopped，不负责与 record lifecycle 比较。

findings.summary: readSettledRunEvidence 未校验 Run state、record.lifecycle 与 proof.terminal_lifecycle 一致，return 互相矛盾的 settled evidence；tests/task-record-durability.test.ts:1519–1559 的 non-canonical 种子正是该矛盾态并断言成功。应在返回前校验三者一致，将 non-canonical 测试改用真实 terminal record，并在约定 seam 增加矛盾时拒绝的测试。

evidence.trigger: 生命周期一致性这一 invariant 存在覆盖缺口：Run row 的 state 为 done，record_json 是合法的 lifecycle=active、artifact_state=active TaskRecord，terminal_proof_json 的 terminal_lifecycle 为 done 且 final_record_hash 正确绑定这些 active record 原始字节。当前 readSettledRunEvidence 仅核验 task_id 和字节 hash，返回 lifecycle=done 的 evidence，其中 record.lifecycle 仍为 active。相同校验也无法拒绝 record.lifecycle=done、proof.terminal_lifecycle=stopped 的组合；现有 hash 篡改测试不能覆盖生命周期矛盾。
caller_chain: tests/task-record-durability.test.ts::settled run evidence binds the proof to the raw committed bytes

findings.summary: lookupBatchCommit 只比较 exported record hash，未比较 exported proof 与 settled Run proof；后续 child 的 commit/persist 中断恢复可接受被改写的 terminal proof。应复用 proofEquals 比较整份 proof，并在 tests/unattended-batch-commit.test.ts 覆盖第二个 child 的中断恢复。

evidence.trigger: 证据绑定 invariant 存在覆盖缺口：batch 已持久化第一个 child 的 commit；第二个 child 完成 commitBatchChild 并写入 durable commit evidence 后，在持久化 committed child 状态前中断。保持 task-record.json 和 proof.final_record_hash 不变，仅将第二个 child 的 exported proof.terminal_lifecycle 改为 stopped，或改写 terminal_event_id/terminalized_at。readAuditTaskPair 仍通过身份和 hash 检查；lookupBatchCommit 在 805–814 只比较 recordRevision，随后从 store record 得到 done 并返回 commit。当前 commitBatchChild 的整份 proof 校验只覆盖新提交；ownUnpersistedBatchHead 的额外校验只覆盖首个 child，不能封闭同一 invariant 的后续 child 恢复路径。

findings.summary: Review exhausted its 5-round rework budget; a durable replan is required.
